description: Fostay's editorial demand calendar (UAE only — Dubai and Abu Dhabi; Goa has no event calendar yet): the upcoming date windows where Dubai and Abu Dhabi hotels predictably spike or sell out (GITEX, F1, NYE, Eid, school breaks...), each with a suggested book-by deadline.
